legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment is assignable by the Assignee, and the Assignor acknowledges that the Assignee may assign this Assignment to a third party without the consent of the Assignor.
legal_clauses.indemnification: The Assignor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Assignee from and against any and all claims, demands, actions, or causes of action arising out of or related to the Assignor's breach of this Assignment.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any dispute arising out of or related to this Assignment shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: The Assignee shall be responsible for closing the transaction and fulfilling all obligations set forth in the Original Contract, and the Assignor shall cooperate with the Assignee to facilitate the closing process.
